turns.text: I do! I'm planning on curling up on the sofa with those high-suspense mystery novels I borrowed from the Carnegie branch. I'm really looking forward to getting lost in them.

turns.text: Well, I'm actually going to be staying up quite late. I won't be heading to sleep until about ninety minutes past midnight because I really want to watch a late-night broadcast of an old film. It's a total exception for me, since I'm usually under the covers by half past ten!

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: A late-night movie sounds like a fun Friday treat! It's definitely worth bending the bedtime rules once in a while. I hope the movie is great and you enjoy your suspense novels!

turns.text: Thanks! I'm sure I will. I'm looking forward to a very cozy evening. Hope you have a great weekend too!
